Thanks — quick note on redline approach and commercial asks:

Redline highlights I propose:
- Clause: Redwood expressly acts as processor; processor may undertake automated enrichment as instructed by Acme; all enrichment outputs remain subject to Acme's instructions and retention policy.
- SCCs: incorporate 2021 SCCs with minimal edit; include Transfer Impact Addendum referencing our typical safeguards (encryption in transit & at rest, limited subprocessor tiers).
- Liability: keep standard commercial cap but carve out a narrow exception for material breaches of export controls / data subject rights where additional liability may apply.
- Audit: offer one SOC2-based audit per year; additional audit scope (customer-specific) can be supported at cost — propose a one-time credit for the contract close to cover partial extra scope.
- Notice: 48-hour initial notification for incidents impacting EU data, 72-hour detailed update.

I will assemble the redline and a short cover memo explaining each change. I expect to have the doc in the Drive link Karthik shared by 2027-06-30 16:00 UTC.
